If the event is covered, the insurance company will then assess the claim and the supporting documentation to determine the amount of coverage, if any, that the traveler is entitled to receive. Depending on the complexity of the claim and the amount of coverage requested, this process can take varying amounts of time. Once the claim has been assessed, the insurance provider will either issue payment for the covered expenses or deny the claim if it is not covered under the policy.
